Brenna Greene on Instagram: "No Oregon natives will see the court for Gonzaga this year at the Moda Center but there is one on their bench in Gonzaga head coach in waiting Brian Michaelson.

Michaelson was a part of Jesuit’s first boys basketball state championship team in 1999. That squad ended up turning into being one of the greatest accumulations of basketball minds our state has ever seen."
content.text: No Oregon natives will see the court for Gonzaga this year at the Moda Center but there is one on their bench in Gonzaga head coach in waiting Brian Michaelson.Michaelson was a part of Jesuit’s first boys basketball state championship team in 1999. That squad ended up turning into being one of the greatest accumulations of basketball minds our state has ever seen.The state of Oregon can’t stand the cheaters at Jesuit…but thanks for reporting.2000 Jefferson team >>>>>Fuck no Jefferson with Brandon brooksI remember watching them, and being like Mike out here dropping 30 and not sweating 😂The 1998 Jesuit team took my beloved Benson Tech down to the wire in the playoffs that year. You could sense Jesuit or Jeff would win it the next year.Brian is very humble that he probably won’t mention that he was the first ever freshman at Jesuit to make Varsity. I was the camera guy that year and he was really cool to get to knowBrian was always cool dude. When I was a kid and he was in highschool he would give us rides from The Hoop to go eat in his mini van 😂Brian Michaelson was so COLD!Jesuit recruits players! Kids come from all over to play sports, that’s the only reason they go there!Would’ve been 3rd place in the PIL. Maybe 4th. Just kidding. Solid squad. I’m sure nepotism had nothing to do with any of this.
